name: Tile-based SDF Rendering with RPN Interpreter
definition: A technique to render large worlds using Signed Distance Functions (SDFs) by dividing the world into tiles, simplifying the SDF expression for each tile, and evaluating it in the fragment shader using an interpreter pattern with Reverse Polish Notation (RPN) command and operand buffers.
summary: Tile-based SDF Rendering with RPN Interpreter renders large worlds by partitioning scenes into tiles and evaluating SDF expressions via a dynamic RPN interpreter, avoiding the shader compilation latency of static code generation.
